interpretation: Utterances are presenter-supplied example corrections, not verified false-alarm labels from the dataset.
Stopping metadata is not proof of a dangerous incident; the demonstration checks visibility for an untouched scope.
code_match corrections take deterministic scoped effect; classifier state also updates from buffered real examples. No claim of production safety validation or measured anomaly accuracy is made.
The offline switch controls this application and does not disconnect Wi-Fi or recall requests already sent.
Synthetic fixture WAVs are clearly labeled scripted replay and do not demonstrate speech recognition.
